# Horaxon Foundation Sprint quote dogfood brief

## Provenance

- Page-system direction: `George-RD/horaxon-web#105`.
- Real draft document/content case: `George-RD/avancus#11`.
- This fixture evaluates Design Studio's visual document lane only. Commercial facts in the source draft remain external content evidence and may change independently.

## Purpose

Design a professional multi-page Foundation Sprint quote that feels like a Horaxon operational working document rather than a glossy brochure or website printed to PDF.

## Page system

- Default physical size: A4.
- Warm working-sheet/paper base for sustained reading.
- Horizon Ink as the primary type/ink role; Dune Gold used sparingly for hierarchy or wayfinding, not decoration.
- Carry IBM Plex family roles where the eventual output format and licensing allow.
- Prefer ruled editorial relationships and open typographic rows over generic SaaS cards.
- Use mono metadata for document ID/date/status/version/page number where those confirmed fields exist.
- Financial/dense tables prioritize scanability, aligned numeric columns, clear totals and repeated headings where a table continues.
- Define explicit rules for page breaks, heading orphans, repeated furniture, final-page treatment and signature/acceptance zones.

## Boundary

Do not decide whether any proposed amount, VAT treatment, legal entity, payment term or acceptance state is current. Do not rewrite business voice. The dogfood case proves page-system design, rendered-page evaluation and reusable renderer-neutral visual codification from confirmed structured inputs.
